candidates: In Vitest test files, configure mock behavior (e.g., `vi.mocked(...).mockReturnValue(...)`, direct property assignments on mocked modules) inside `beforeEach` hooks rather than inline in individual test bodies. When distinct groups of tests need different mock configurations, use nested `describe` blocks each with their own `beforeEach` that sets the appropriate mock state. Never manually reset mock state at the end of a test case; instead rely on `vi.clearAllMocks()` (or `vi.resetAllMocks()`) in a top-level `beforeEach`, and scope differing configurations to nested `describe` blocks. This keeps test bodies focused purely on assertions and prevents accidental cross-test state leakage.
